_about: Adjudication of the class each model named on the cases where it was verdict-right: fired on the
vulnerable variant on at least one valid run and stayed silent on the fixed variant on every valid run.
Directories suffixed -partial or -calibration are not sweeps and are not adjudicated.
`named` lists the class strings the model returned on the vulnerable runs (the full string from its
JSON answer; the `note` field on the artefact line is the same string cut at 60 characters).
A case counts if any named string counts; otherwise it is disputed if any is disputed; otherwise no.
Strict detections = counts only. Lenient detections = counts + disputed.
Every rule below is one human judgement, applied by an agent, and is open to dispute.
derivation: post-hoc adjudication of the free-text class names in raw/model-*/runs.jsonl under the owner's rule of 2026-09-02, applied by an agent after reading the answers; not a rule map and not pre-registered, because it cannot be (KNOWN-LIMITATIONS 49)
rule: a named class counts as the class present when it names the mechanism or a clear synonym of it; naming only the effect does not count; a name that fits both the real class and a different one, or names the vulnerable spot without the missing check, is disputed; a generic phrase such as 'Missing account validation' alone does not count; a different mechanism does not count
